headline: Stlican Shelf Erupts; Hollow Stirs; Berm and Expanse Bleed
war_summary: The field's center of gravity has swung since our last edition went to press. The Stlican Shelf now tops every ledger: better than eight hundred Colonial and a thousand Warden losses in two hours, the pace still climbing, and one Warden post reduced to no-man's-land, seven flags holding for the Colonials against one. Palantine Berm has not relented; another Colonial-held post lies in ruin there, four flags to two Warden, with Vendett and Windburn Landing the busiest ground about the region. The Weathered Expanse has yielded yet another Warden stronghold to the wrecks, five now standing amid four ruins, Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest still churning. Marban Hollow has awakened: thirty-six flag actions in a day at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, the last logged as this dispatch was filed. Godcrofts, long still, sprang to life with eleven actions in two hours about Fleecewatch, Isawa, and Ursa Base. Farranac Coast bleeds heavily around its lone Warden post, and Callahans Passage exacts a grim toll without a flag stirring. Linn Mercy and the Nevish Line have gone silent after their ordeals; Stonecradle and the Gutter rest as well. Thirty-four victory towns remain the prize; neither side claims the war.
